headline: Al-Amanah taps GCash to boost financial inclusion in Mindanao
summary: The Philippine state-owned Al-Amanah Islamic Investment Bank signed a memorandum of agreement with e-wallet GCash. It aims to build digital payment and fund disbursement solutions in Mindanao.
why: Digital payment partnerships between banks and e-wallets are a common way to widen access to financial services in underbanked regions.
